title: Create an app store version localization

abstract.text: Add localized version-level information for a new locale.
An error occurred with your request.
The provided resource data is not valid.

prose.text: If the App Store version and the app info don’t have the same set of localizations, you will receive an erorr when you submit the version to the App Store.

paragraphs.text: Use this endpoint to add localized version information for a new locale. Be sure to use `POST-v1-appInfoLocalizations` to add the same locale to the version as well.

> **Important**
>
>  If the App Store version and the app info don’t have the same set of localizations, you will receive an erorr when you submit the version to the App Store.
